description.zh-CN: 本地运行的私人具身 AI：一个命令装好，通过 Telegram、飞书、钉钉、网页控制台和你聊天，自带技能、定时任务与自我进化记忆，密钥只留在你自己电脑上。
description.en: A self-hosted personal embodied AI: one-command install, talks to you over Telegram, Feishu, DingTalk and a loopback web console, with skills, scheduling and self-evolution memory — credentials never leave your machine.

runtime.note: Python 3.10+ / bash / tmux 为官方前置条件（docs/installation.md）。Windows 的正式路线是 WSL2（控制台与服务跑在 WSL 内，原生 shell 仅 attach-only）；macOS 官方标注 expected-but-untested。tmux 在 WSL 内需 `sudo apt-get install tmux`（管理员权限）→ 已降级为安装前手动步骤，AiBOX 安装脚本不代装。

packages.name: AiDog source archive (Windows via WSL2)
packages.hashSource: GitHub tag source archive full download sha256 measured locally (2026-11-12); gh-proxy channel re-downloaded and matched

channels.note: Version-pinned tag source archive (docs: git is optional, archives can run). Daily probe re-downloads and re-hashes (package < 5 MB).
Community GitHub accelerator (2026-11-12 measured 200, same size 3695753, sha256 identical to direct). ghfast.top answers HEAD without Content-Length for archive URLs → not used here.

args: set -e; W=$(wslpath "$(cmd.exe /c echo %USERPROFILE% 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"); S=$(mktemp -d); tar -xzf "$W/.aibox/cache/downloads/v0.5.88.tar.gz" -C "$S"; mkdir -p "$HOME/aidog"; cp -a "$S"/AiDog-0.5.88/. "$HOME/aidog/"; rm -rf "$S"; bash "$HOME/aidog/deploy/install.sh"
install.notes: Windows route = WSL2 (official reference platform). The script locates the AiBOX-cached source archive from inside WSL, unpacks it to ~/aidog (official Quick Start path) and runs the official one-command installer `deploy/install.sh` (provision + boot + verify, idempotent). Prerequisites inside WSL: Python 3.10+, tmux (manual, admin), a free port 19167. Re-running merges the new version over an existing checkout. direct-install.note: Both platform steps share one version-pinned source archive; steps are filtered by machine. Windows runs inside WSL2.

openai-compatible.label: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (default: local gateway, no key needed)

recommendedModels.name: MiMo v2.6 Flash
recommendedModels.note: Shipped default model of the local gateway (zero-config)

openai-compatible.notes: Settings live in web/settings.json inside the checkout (mycore.base_url + mycore.model); default endpoint http://127.0.0.1:3460/v1 with model mimo-v2.6-flash. Any OpenAI-compatible provider works; MODEL_API_KEY in secrets.env is optional and only needed when the endpoint requires a key (docs/installation.md). Configured via `aidog setup` or the console — file path assumes the documented ~/aidog install dir; TODO real-machine confirmation.

upgrade.notes: Update check = local probe (installed VERSION) vs the upstream latest tag recorded by the daily probe (same data source). Official upgrade inside a git clone: `aidog update apply` (dirty-tree guard, ff-only, restart); archive installs upgrade by re-running the AiBOX install (merge-over) or re-cloning.

steps: Stop the runtime: `bash ~/aidog/deploy/boot_services.sh stop` (inside WSL on Windows)
Delete the install directory ~/aidog — machine-local state (secrets.env, web/settings.json, deploy/*.local, data/) lives beside the code
Optionally remove tmux inside WSL if you installed it only for AiDog (needs admin, done manually)
uninstall.notes: Upstream design: removing the directory removes everything (docs/installation.md §Uninstall). No system services outside the checkout; the watchdog/tmux sessions must be stopped first.

risk.onUninstall: 密钥（secrets.env）、聊天会话记忆与控制台配置全都存在安装目录 ~/aidog 里，删除后全部消失——请先备份 secrets.env 和 data/ / Your credentials (secrets.env), chat memory and console settings all live in ~/aidog — deleting it wipes them; back up secrets.env and data/ first.
